_about: Canonical menu composition for every page. Nutrition is the sum of the component values in components.json (Waffle House’s published per-component nutrition); each recipe follows the meal composition Waffle House lists (sides default to hashbrowns and white toast). Typical prices and ranges are in prices.json.

categories.title: All-Star Special™
categories.intro: The All-Star Special is the biggest breakfast on the menu: a sweet cream waffle, two scrambled eggs, toast, hashbrowns (or grits or sliced tomatoes) and a choice of bacon, sausage or city ham. The figures below assume hashbrowns and white toast.
categories.label: Breakfast

items.name: All-Star Special with Bacon
items.desc: Sweet cream waffle, two scrambled eggs, white toast, regular hashbrowns and three slices of bacon.

items.name: All-Star Special with Sausage
items.desc: Sweet cream waffle, two scrambled eggs, white toast, regular hashbrowns and two sausage patties.

items.name: All-Star Special with City Ham
items.desc: Sweet cream waffle, two scrambled eggs, white toast, regular hashbrowns and a slice of hickory smoked city ham.

categories.title: Breakfast Hashbrown Bowls
categories.intro: Each breakfast bowl starts with a large order of hashbrowns, two slices of melted American cheese and two scrambled eggs, then adds crumbled meat. The Chicken Fiesta Protein Bowl swaps the hashbrowns for grilled chicken and three eggs.
categories.label: Breakfast

items.name: Sausage Egg & Cheese Hashbrown Bowl
items.desc: Large hashbrowns, two slices of American cheese, two scrambled eggs and two crumbled sausage patties.

items.name: Bacon Egg & Cheese Hashbrown Bowl
items.desc: Large hashbrowns, two slices of American cheese, two scrambled eggs and three slices of crumbled bacon.

items.name: Ham Egg & Cheese Hashbrown Bowl
items.desc: Large hashbrowns, two slices of American cheese, two scrambled eggs and chunks of hickory smoked ham.

items.name: Chicken Fiesta Protein Bowl
items.desc: Grilled chicken, three scrambled eggs, two slices of American cheese, grilled onions, tomatoes and jalapeños.

categories.title: Egg Breakfasts
categories.intro: Every egg breakfast comes with two scrambled eggs, toast and jelly, and a choice of grits, hashbrowns or sliced tomatoes. Add a steak, chop, ham or chicken for a bigger plate. Figures assume hashbrowns and white toast; jelly is not included.

categories.title: Toddle House Omelets
categories.intro: Toddle House omelets are served with toast and jelly and a choice of grits, hashbrowns or sliced tomatoes. Figures assume the standard omelet, hashbrowns and white toast.

categories.title: Waffles
categories.intro: The sweet cream waffle is the item the chain is named for. Pecan pieces are baked in; chocolate chips and peanut butter chips go on top. Syrup and butter are not included in the figures.

categories.title: Hashbrowns & Toppings
categories.intro: Hashbrowns come regular, large or triple, and each topping has its own one-word call: smothered (onions), covered (cheese), chunked (ham), diced (tomatoes), peppered (jalapeños), capped (mushrooms), topped (chili) and country (sausage gravy). Ask for all of them and the order is "all the way".
